notes.title: New DLC announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Did you know that Mizi isn’t just fascinated by fragile objects but also loves to 'take care' of all kinds of paper—with her claws? 😉

Introducing our next DLC: Mizi NO! - Paperwork 📜 😽 🐾

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592670/Mizi_NO__Paperwork

But that’s not all—the game is now also available in Czech and Ukrainian!

notes.title: New DLC Now Available: Kintsugi
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Who here hasn’t heard of Kintsugi? It’s a traditional method of repairing ceramics!

As you may know, Mizi is quite the expert at breaking pottery. So why not try your hand at Kintsugi and piece those items together?

This DLC includes 20 new items inspired by Asian culture. Enjoy the upcoming weekend! And if you don’t have any plans yet, why not spend some time tidying up Mizi’s mess?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2900180/Mizi_NO__Kintsugi/

notes.title: New localizations added: Français, Nederlands, Norsk, Polski
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

With this update, we want to introduce four new languages to the game! 

But honestly, Mizi wouldn't care if you'd say Non, Nee, Ingen, or Nie... It would still knock off anything it can get its paw on off the table. :-D

Thank you for playing our game and fixing all the pottery.

Cheers!

notes.title: Fix for minor technical things
notes.content:
Hello puzzle friends!

With this patch, we are fixing some minor technical issues.

[list]
    [*]Everyone who was affected by a problem with the save game file should be able to start the game normally again

All the best and have a great day!

notes.title: Mizi NO! - OUT NOW
notes.content:
Mizi NO! is out NOW! 🎉 ✨ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654860/Mizi_NO/

Despite us telling Mizi "NO!" many times, our mischievous cat didn’t listen. As if any cat ever would...😼 
Mizi walked across the keyboard, pressed alllll the wrong buttons, and accidentally released the game. Thanks, Mizi... 😉

But honestly, we truly hope you’ll enjoy the relaxing puzzle environment we've created. 
We had a blast making the game, and if you're curious about a look behind the scenes, you can check out Simone's devlog videos on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3CazngphiA8&list=PLbz7bMKeJC55YJWhofSmRKVcBuZFLAtiE]Youtube[/url]!

If you have any feedback regarding the game (or funny cat stories), please share them with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/E2tR2mQ2KX]Discord[/url] or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2654860/discussions/]Steam forum[/url]. ❤️

notes.title: 🔥 Virtual Cottage 2! 🔥
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943180/Virtual_Cottage_2][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38802078/67b70df74d88be7efe810e4e584282ba34f778af.jpg[/img][/url]

Dear Friends,

When we launched Virtual Cottage in October 2020 as our first game/app on Steam, we had no idea where it would lead us.

We initially intended to create a screen blocker to help you focus on your work and avoid distractions like social media.

However, over the years, you have all shared valuable ideas, feature requests, and ways you interact with Virtual Cottage. It became clear to us that a significant overhaul was due.

So, we're thrilled to present Virtual Cottage 2! It comes with three different timers (Classic Timer, Stopwatch, and Pomodoro) and an improved To-Do List (rearrange tasks, create categories, and set up repeating daily routines). This time, you’ll also be able to add your music. 

But now, the most requested feature of all time (we heard you loud and clear!): [b]Cottage customization[/b]. 

You will be able to choose between different room layouts in the beginning and add more as time goes by. The game will also offer a wide selection of furniture items to place inside your home. We wanted you to have the ability to create your ultimate cozy space! You will get rewarded one item (and its colour variations) per day, simply by using Virtual Cottage. And yes, there will be pets…this time, you won't have to choose between them—you can have them all active simultaneously!

We are super excited about this and hope you are as well!! 

If you wanna be up-to-date with the development or leave us some more input, you’re welcome to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/E2tR2mQ2KX]discord[/url] :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943180/Virtual_Cottage_2
